messages.content: read README.md and summarize what helm is

Step 'Inspect environment & tools' completed by ResearchWorker: Helm is an open-source package manager for Kubernetes that simplifies the deployment and management of applications on Kubernetes clusters. It provides a declarative way to define, install, upgrade, and manage complex applications on Kubernetes. Helm uses charts, which are packages of pre-configured Kubernetes resources, to encapsulate application dependencies and configurations. This allows developers to package their applications along with all necessary components into a single unit for easy deployment and management.
